aircraft carrier.name: an aircraft carrier
aircraft carrier.line: A whole airport that swims. Mind where it lands.

airplane.name: an airplane
airplane.line: Up it goes. I never bother with tickets myself.

alarm clock.name: an alarm clock
alarm clock.line: It's always six o'clock somewhere. Usually at tea.

ambulance.name: an ambulance
ambulance.line: In a hurry, and heavy with it. Do stand aside.

angel.name: an angel
angel.line: Wings and good manners. It rises above things.

animal migration.name: a flock of birds
animal migration.line: Everyone leaving at once. How fashionable.

ant.name: an ant
ant.line: Small enough to be overlooked. I envy it.

anvil.name: an anvil
anvil.line: Heavy as a Monday. Do mind her toes.

apple.name: an apple
apple.line: An apple a day keeps the ceiling near.

arm.name: an arm
arm.line: An arm, all on its own. How disarming.

asparagus.name: asparagus
asparagus.line: Eat your greens and grow. Nannies were right, annoyingly.

axe.name: an axe
axe.line: Only a picture of one. Nobody's head is in danger.

backpack.name: a backpack
backpack.line: Packed with everything but sense, I expect.

banana.name: a banana
banana.line: The oldest joke there is. Do watch her step.

bandage.name: a bandage
bandage.line: It sticks to whatever it meets. Rather clingy.

barn.name: a barn
barn.line: Big, red, and going nowhere in a hurry.

baseball.name: a baseball
baseball.line: It bounces, it rolls, it finds windows. Busy thing.

baseball bat.name: a baseball bat
baseball bat.line: A stick with ambitions. Down here it stays a stick.

basket.name: a basket
basket.line: For eggs. All of them at once, against advice.

basketball.name: a basketball
basketball.line: Bounce is its whole personality. I rather respect that.

bat.name: a bat
bat.line: Twinkle, twinkle, little bat. How I wonder what you're at.

bathtub.name: a bathtub
bathtub.line: Soapy and smooth. Dignity is not guaranteed.

beach.name: a beach
beach.line: Sand as far as she can walk. It stays put.

bear.name: a bear
bear.line: Large, furry and heavy. Do not ask it to dance.

beard.name: a beard
beard.line: A beard without a face. I know the feeling.

bed.name: a bed
bed.line: For sleeping, officially. For jumping, obviously.

bee.name: a bee
bee.line: Busy, buzzy, and up. It has places to be.

belt.name: a belt
belt.line: It holds things up. Trousers, mostly. Not girls.

bench.name: a bench
bench.line: A place to sit and think. Or just sit.

bicycle.name: a bicycle
bicycle.line: Two wheels and a wobble. Nobody's pedalling, mind.

binoculars.name: binoculars
binoculars.line: Far things near, near things far. Depends which end.

bird.name: a bird
bird.line: It rises. Birds do, given half a sky.

birthday cake.name: a birthday cake
birthday cake.line: A very merry unbirthday. Eat me, say the candles.

blackberry.name: a blackberry
blackberry.line: A small bite, a small growth. Fair is fair.

blueberry.name: a blueberry
blueberry.line: Tiny, blue and ambitious. She'll grow a little.

book.name: a book
book.line: What is the use of a book without pictures?

boomerang.name: a boomerang
boomerang.line: Throw it away and it disagrees. I like it.

bottlecap.name: a bottle cap
bottlecap.line: A lid with nothing to keep a lid on.

bowtie.name: a bow tie
bowtie.line: Very dapper. It weighs less than a compliment.

bracelet.name: a bracelet
bracelet.line: A circle with somewhere to be. A wrist, usually.

brain.name: a brain
brain.line: A brain! Do pass it round. We're all mad here.

bread.name: bread
bread.line: A loaf to grow on. Butter not included.

bridge.name: a bridge
bridge.line: Solid as a fact. Cross it when she comes to it.

broccoli.name: broccoli
broccoli.line: A little tree you can eat. She'll sprout too.

broom.name: a broom
broom.line: Sweeps by day, flies by night. It's night somewhere.

bucket.name: a bucket
bucket.line: Full of nothing, which is still something.

bulldozer.name: a bulldozer
bulldozer.line: It moves mountains, slowly. Nothing moves it.

bus.name: a bus
bus.line: Heavy, and late, I expect. Buses usually are.

bush.name: a bush
bush.line: Springy twigs all the way through. A leafy cushion.

butterfly.name: a butterfly
butterfly.line: It was a caterpillar once. Ask it who it is.

cactus.name: a cactus
cactus.line: Prickly company. One touch and she begins again.

cake.name: a cake
cake.line: Eat me, it says. She usually does.

calculator.name: a calculator
calculator.line: Four times five is twelve. It disagrees. How dull.

calendar.name: a calendar
calendar.line: Jam tomorrow and jam yesterday, but never jam today.

camel.name: a camel
camel.line: One hump or two? Heavy either way.

camera.name: a camera
camera.line: Say Cheshire. I photograph terribly well, in parts.

camouflage.name: camouflage
camouflage.line: I can't see it either. We'd get along.

campfire.name: a campfire
campfire.line: Warm from a distance. Do keep her at one.

candle.name: a candle
candle.line: A small flame, but it nips. Mind her fingers.

cannon.name: a cannon
cannon.line: Only cardboard and ink. It won't go off.

canoe.name: a canoe
canoe.line: A boat in want of a river. Paddle not included.

car.name: a car
car.line: Heavy, and nobody driving. It will sit and sulk.

carrot.name: a carrot
carrot.line: The White Rabbit swears by them. Up she grows.

castle.name: a castle
castle.line: Stone upon stone. The Queen will want the keys.

cat.name: a cat
cat.line: A relative, I think. The grin needs work.

ceiling fan.name: a ceiling fan
ceiling fan.line: Round and round. Fanning makes her smaller, remember?

cello.name: a cello
cello.line: A violin that ate the cake. Deep voice, too.

cell phone.name: a cell phone
cell phone.line: Nobody's calling. Nobody often does, down here.

chair.name: a chair
chair.line: Sit, by all means. It's sturdier than it looks.

chandelier.name: a chandelier
chandelier.line: Grand and heavy. Best admired from one side.

church.name: a church
church.line: Steeple, bells and a great deal of stone.

circle.name: a circle
circle.line: Round and round with no end. My favourite argument.

clarinet.name: a clarinet
clarinet.line: All those keys and not one opens a door.

clock.name: a clock
clock.line: Two days slow. The Hatter blames the butter.

cloud.name: a cloud
cloud.line: Up it goes. Soft to look at, tricky to sit on.

coffee cup.name: a coffee cup
coffee cup.line: Drink me, but hot. Do blow on it first.

compass.name: a compass
compass.line: It knows where north is. Not where she's going.

computer.name: a computer
computer.line: It thinks in ones and noughts. How very limiting.

cookie.name: a cookie
cookie.line: Eat me, down to the crumbs. Up she goes.

cooler.name: a cooler
cooler.line: Cold inside, I'm told. Picnics take it everywhere.

couch.name: a couch
couch.line: Made for sitting. Destined for jumping.

cow.name: a cow
cow.line: Over the moon, was it? Not at that weight.

crab.name: a crab
crab.line: It goes sideways on purpose. I approve.

crayon.name: a crayon
crayon.line: A rival pen. I shall pretend not to notice.

crocodile.name: a crocodile
crocodile.line: How doth the little crocodile? With gently smiling jaws.

crown.name: a crown
crown.line: The eighth square at last. Queen Alice, I presume.

cruise ship.name: a cruise ship
cruise ship.line: A floating hotel. Rather less floating, down here.

cup.name: a cup
cup.line: Drink me. One sip and the world gets roomier.

diamond.name: a diamond
diamond.line: Hard, bright, and quite sure of itself.

dishwasher.name: a dishwasher
dishwasher.line: A heavy box of other people's plates.

diving board.name: a diving board
diving board.line: Springy. Do look before she leaps.

dog.name: a dog
dog.line: It wags when it's pleased. I do the opposite.

dolphin.name: a dolphin
dolphin.line: Sleek as a wet excuse. Nothing to hold on to.

donut.name: a donut
donut.line: Eat me, and mind the hole. It's the best part.

door.name: a door
door.line: A way out. Or in. It depends which side.

dragon.name: a dragon
dragon.line: Up it goes, with opinions. Do hold on.

dresser.name: a dresser
dresser.line: Drawers full of heavy secrets. It shan't budge easily.

drill.name: a drill
drill.line: It makes holes. Rabbits manage without one.

drums.name: drums
drums.line: Boing and boom. Everything on them keeps the beat.

duck.name: a duck
duck.line: The Duck ran the Caucus-race. Still bobbing about.

dumbbell.name: a dumbbell
dumbbell.line: Heavy on purpose. People lift these for fun, apparently.

ear.name: an ear
ear.line: An ear! Careful what you say around it.

elbow.name: an elbow
elbow.line: An elbow. Every arm's change of mind.

elephant.name: an elephant
elephant.line: It never forgets, and the floor won't either.

envelope.name: an envelope
envelope.line: Light as a rumour, and probably carrying one.

eraser.name: an eraser
eraser.line: Rubber through and through. It bounces back from mistakes.

eye.name: an eye
eye.line: It's rude to stare. I should know.

eyeglasses.name: spectacles
eyeglasses.line: For seeing what's there. I manage without being there.

face.name: a face
face.line: A face! Most of mine is optional.

fan.name: a fan
fan.line: The Rabbit's fan. Keep fanning and she'll vanish entirely.

feather.name: a feather
feather.line: Light as a rumour. A sneeze would move it.

fence.name: a fence
fence.line: Meant to keep her out. The rungs say otherwise.

finger.name: a finger
finger.line: Pointing at what, exactly? Oh. Me.

fire hydrant.name: a fire hydrant
fire hydrant.line: Full of water and patience. Dogs adore it.

fireplace.name: a fireplace
fireplace.line: Cosy from the rug. Less so from inside.

firetruck.name: a fire truck
firetruck.line: Ladders, hoses and a great deal of red.

fish.name: a fish
fish.line: Slippery customer. The Footman was one, you know.

flamingo.name: a flamingo
flamingo.line: The Queen's croquet mallet. It would rather fly off.

flashlight.name: a flashlight
flashlight.line: It points out the obvious. Brightly.

flip flops.name: flip flops
flip flops.line: Flip, then flop. Always in that order.

floor lamp.name: a floor lamp
floor lamp.line: A lamp that stands up for itself.

flower.name: a flower
flower.line: The flowers talk here. This one is petal-light and shy.

flying saucer.name: a flying saucer
flying saucer.line: Near enough. Up it goes. Teacup not included.

foot.name: a foot
foot.line: Alice's Right Foot, Esquire. She once sent it presents.

fork.name: a fork
fork.line: A fork. In the road, I'd take it.

frog.name: a frog
frog.line: All legs and leaping. The other Footman was one.

frying pan.name: a frying pan
frying pan.line: Greased and ready. The Cook throws these, so duck.

garden.name: a garden
garden.line: The loveliest garden you ever saw. So that's where she's going.

garden hose.name: a garden hose
garden hose.line: A rope with a drip. Up she goes, damply.

giraffe.name: a giraffe
giraffe.line: Mostly neck. Climb politely, it has feelings.

goatee.name: a goatee
goatee.line: A small beard with large opinions.

golf club.name: a golf club
golf club.line: The Queen prefers flamingos. This one won't squawk, at least.

grapes.name: grapes
grapes.line: One at a time, she grows by the inch.

grass.name: grass
grass.line: Ground with a haircut. It stays where it's planted.

guitar.name: a guitar
guitar.line: Six strings and nobody strumming. A quiet sort of music.

hamburger.name: a hamburger
hamburger.line: Eat me, with both hands. Up she goes.

hammer.name: a hammer
hammer.line: Heavy at one end. To it, everything's a nail.

hand.name: a hand
hand.line: A hand! I'd applaud, but mine come and go.

harp.name: a harp
harp.line: All strings, no fingers. It hums when nobody listens.

hat.name: a hat
hat.line: In this style, ten and six. The Hatter wants it back.

headphones.name: headphones
headphones.line: Music for two ears only. How secretive.

hedgehog.name: a hedgehog
hedgehog.line: The Queen's croquet ball. Prickly about it, too.

helicopter.name: a helicopter
helicopter.line: Near enough. Up it goes, chopping the air.

helmet.name: a helmet
helmet.line: Sensible. The White Knight fell off anyway.

hockey puck.name: a hockey puck
hockey puck.line: Born on ice. It slides and never apologises.

hockey stick.name: a hockey stick
hockey stick.line: A stick with a bend in its plans.

horse.name: a horse
horse.line: A noble beast. Heavy in the hoof.

hospital.name: a hospital
hospital.line: A big building full of getting better.

hot air balloon.name: a hot air balloon
hot air balloon.line: Up it goes. Most things do, if you let go.

hot dog.name: a hot dog
hot dog.line: Neither hot nor a dog. Eat it and grow.

hot tub.name: a hot tub
hot tub.line: Warm, bubbly and slippery. Tea for the whole body.

hourglass.name: an hourglass
hourglass.line: Time runs through its waist. The Rabbit can't bear to look.

house.name: a house
house.line: Heavy with chimneys. She outgrew one once, you know.

house plant.name: a house plant
house plant.line: Water it and it's a beanstalk. Up she goes.

hurricane.name: a hurricane
hurricane.line: Wind with a temper. Best admired from elsewhere.

ice cream.name: an ice cream
ice cream.line: Eat me, quickly, before it becomes a puddle.

jacket.name: a jacket
jacket.line: A jacket with nobody in it. Lighter that way.

jail.name: a jail
jail.line: Stole some tarts, did we? The bars make fine rungs.

kangaroo.name: a kangaroo
kangaroo.line: Bounce is a family tradition. Mind her head.

key.name: a key
key.line: A lovely picture of a key.

keyboard.name: a keyboard
keyboard.line: Every letter, in no sensible order. My kind of alphabet.

knee.name: a knee
knee.line: A knee. It bends, but only one way.

knife.name: a knife
knife.line: Only ink. It couldn't cut butter, best or otherwise.

ladder.name: a ladder
ladder.line: Rung by rung, then. I prefer to simply appear.

lantern.name: a lantern
lantern.line: Light it and let go. It wanders upward.

laptop.name: a laptop
laptop.line: A book that glows and argues back.

leaf.name: a leaf
leaf.line: Light as a whisper. It falls when it remembers to.

leg.name: a leg
leg.line: A leg, going nowhere. It needs a partner.

light bulb.name: a light bulb
light bulb.line: Light by name, light by nature. I do love a pun.

lighter.name: a lighter
lighter.line: A pocketful of fire. Small, but it nips.

lighthouse.name: a lighthouse
lighthouse.line: Stairs all the way up, and a view.

lightning.name: lightning
lightning.line: It never strikes twice. Once is plenty.

line.name: a line
line.line: A line. Every drawing's first step and last resort.

lion.name: a lion
lion.line: A cousin of mine. Bigger teeth, smaller grin.

lipstick.name: a lipstick
lipstick.line: For painting smiles on. Mine came free.

lobster.name: a lobster
lobster.line: Will you, won't you, join the dance? Lobsters insist.

lollipop.name: a lollipop
lollipop.line: Eat me, one lick at a time. Slow growing.

mailbox.name: a mailbox
mailbox.line: Parcels for her own feet go here. Long story.

map.name: a map
map.line: Useful, if she cares where she's going.

marker.name: a marker
marker.line: My sort of pen. Do put the cap back.

matches.name: matches
matches.line: Little sticks with big ideas. Keep her clear.

megaphone.name: a megaphone
megaphone.line: For those who prefer to be heard twice.

mermaid.name: a mermaid
mermaid.line: Half girl, half fish, wholly slippery.

microphone.name: a microphone
microphone.line: Speak up. Or don't. It listens either way.

microwave.name: a microwave
microwave.line: A box that hums and hurries supper.

monkey.name: a monkey
monkey.line: It climbs everything. Nothing much climbs it.

moon.name: the moon
moon.line: It rises nightly. Some say it borrowed my grin.

mosquito.name: a mosquito
mosquito.line: A very small opinion, loudly held. Up it whines.

motorbike.name: a motorbike
motorbike.line: Two wheels, much noise, considerable weight.

mountain.name: a mountain
mountain.line: It shan't come to her. She must go to it.

mouse.name: a mouse
mouse.line: Oh, a mouse! Best not mention me. Or Dinah.

moustache.name: a moustache
moustache.line: A moustache with nobody behind it. I sympathise.

mouth.name: a mouth
mouth.line: Grin with it. It's the last thing to go.

mug.name: a mug
mug.line: Drink me, in a sturdier cup.

mushroom.name: a mushroom
mushroom.line: One side makes her taller. The top makes her fly.

nail.name: a nail
nail.line: It stays where it's put. Stubborn, like the Duchess.

necklace.name: a necklace
necklace.line: A chain for wearing, not climbing. Pity.

nose.name: a nose
nose.line: A nose! It runs in most families.

ocean.name: the ocean
ocean.line: A pool of tears, only saltier. Slippery going.

octagon.name: an octagon
octagon.line: Eight sides. It usually says stop. I never do.

octopus.name: an octopus
octopus.line: Eight arms, all suckers. It does get attached.

onion.name: an onion
onion.line: Eat it and grow. Cry a little first.

oven.name: an oven
oven.line: A heavy box for tarts. Somebody always steals those.

owl.name: an owl
owl.line: Wise, they say. Wise enough to fly off.

paintbrush.name: a paintbrush
paintbrush.line: Painting the roses red? Wet paint sticks to everything.

paint can.name: a paint can
paint can.line: Red, for the roses. Sticky till it dries.

palm tree.name: a palm tree
palm tree.line: Straight up, coconuts at the top. Hold on tight.

panda.name: a panda
panda.line: Black, white and heavy all over.

pants.name: pants
pants.line: Trousers out walking alone. Light on their feet.

paper clip.name: a paper clip
paper clip.line: It holds things together. Somebody has to.

parachute.name: a parachute
parachute.line: It argues with gravity. Politely, but it wins.

parrot.name: a parrot
parrot.line: It repeats everything. It repeats everything. Up it goes.

passport.name: a passport
passport.line: Papers for leaving. Nobody checks them down a rabbit hole.

peanut.name: a peanut
peanut.line: A small snack for a small growth.

pear.name: a pear
pear.line: Eat me, it says, in a pear-shaped voice.

peas.name: peas
peas.line: Tiny, green and good for her. Up a little.

pencil.name: a pencil
pencil.line: Another pen! This board has room for two. Just.

penguin.name: a penguin
penguin.line: Dressed for dinner, built for sliding.

piano.name: a piano
piano.line: Grand, and heavy with it. Mind her toes.

pickup truck.name: a pickup truck
pickup truck.line: Heavy, with room in the back for more heavy.

picture frame.name: a picture frame
picture frame.line: A frame round nothing. I've sat for that portrait.

pig.name: a pig
pig.line: It was a baby a minute ago. Do keep up.

pillow.name: a pillow
pillow.line: Soft landing, gentle bounce. Sweet dreams on the way up.

pineapple.name: a pineapple
pineapple.line: Prickly outside, growth inside. Eat carefully.

pizza.name: a pizza
pizza.line: Eat me, by the slice. Up she goes.

pliers.name: pliers
pliers.line: A firm grip and no conversation.

police car.name: a police car
police car.line: Heavy, with a flashing hat. Nobody's in trouble. Yet.

pond.name: a pond
pond.line: Still water. Slippery at the edges, like most truths.

pool.name: a pool
pool.line: She swam in her own tears once. Slippery stuff.

popsicle.name: a popsicle
popsicle.line: Ice on a stick. Slippery until it's gone.

postcard.name: a postcard
postcard.line: Wish you were here. Wherever here is.

potato.name: a potato
potato.line: Eat me, it says, plainly. Potatoes don't show off.

power outlet.name: a power outlet
power outlet.line: It looks shocked. So would she be. Hands off.

purse.name: a purse
purse.line: Full of everything except what you're looking for.

rabbit.name: a rabbit
rabbit.line: Late again, I expect. Springy, though.

raccoon.name: a raccoon
raccoon.line: A bandit's mask, and nothing stolen yet.

radio.name: a radio
radio.line: Voices from nowhere. I do that too.

rain.name: rain
rain.line: Wet all the way down. Mind her footing.

rainbow.name: a rainbow
rainbow.line: A bridge made of weather. It holds, if she believes.

rake.name: a rake
rake.line: Step on it and it answers back.

remote control.name: a remote control
remote control.line: So many buttons. None of them work on me.

rhinoceros.name: a rhinoceros
rhinoceros.line: A ton of bad eyesight. It shan't budge.

rifle.name: a rifle
rifle.line: None of that down here. It's only ink.

river.name: a river
river.line: Wet and in a hurry. Nothing to hold on to.

roller coaster.name: a roller coaster
roller coaster.line: Up, down and shrieking. Climb it, if she dares.

rollerskates.name: roller skates
rollerskates.line: Wheels for feet. Dignity is not guaranteed.

sailboat.name: a sailboat
sailboat.line: All sail and no anchor. The wind decides.

sandwich.name: a sandwich
sandwich.line: Eat me, between two slices. Up she goes.

saw.name: a saw
saw.line: It has seen better days. Saw them, even.

saxophone.name: a saxophone
saxophone.line: Bent like a question. Sounds like an answer.

school bus.name: a school bus
school bus.line: Yellow, heavy and full of lessons.

scissors.name: scissors
scissors.line: Snip, snip. Only paper need worry, and this is ink.

scorpion.name: a scorpion
scorpion.line: A sting in its tale. Do keep her back.

screwdriver.name: a screwdriver
screwdriver.line: A turn or two and things stay put.

sea turtle.name: a sea turtle
sea turtle.line: The Mock Turtle's real cousin. Slow, wet and sentimental.

see saw.name: a seesaw
see saw.line: What goes down must come up, apparently.

shark.name: a shark
shark.line: All teeth and no grin. Do keep her clear.

sheep.name: a sheep
sheep.line: A cloud with legs. Woolly landings all round.

shoe.name: a shoe
shoe.line: One shoe. The other is always somewhere else.

shorts.name: shorts
shorts.line: Trousers that stopped early. Light as a breeze.

shovel.name: a shovel
shovel.line: For digging holes. Rabbits do it without one.

sink.name: a sink
sink.line: Everything but the kitchen. No, wait. Exactly the kitchen.

skateboard.name: a skateboard
skateboard.line: A plank on wheels. Off it goes, with or without her.

skull.name: a skull
skull.line: Alas, poor somebody. Best she keeps her distance.

skyscraper.name: a skyscraper
skyscraper.line: A very tall ladder with offices in it.

sleeping bag.name: a sleeping bag
sleeping bag.line: A bed you can carry. A gentle bounce.

smiley face.name: a smiley face
smiley face.line: A grin without much else. I approve entirely.

snail.name: a snail
snail.line: Will you walk a little faster? It leaves a slippery trail.

snake.name: a snake
snake.line: Serpent! cried the Pigeon. Smooth, anyway. Nothing to grip.

snorkel.name: a snorkel
snorkel.line: For breathing where one shouldn't. Handy in a pool of tears.

snowflake.name: a snowflake
snowflake.line: No two alike, and none of them weigh a thing.

snowman.name: a snowman
snowman.line: Cold company. Icy to stand on, too.

soccer ball.name: a soccer ball
soccer ball.line: Kick it and it comes back. Bouncy, loyal thing.

sock.name: a sock
sock.line: One sock. The other vanished. I know how.

speedboat.name: a speedboat
speedboat.line: It skims. Fast, wet, and gone.

spider.name: a spider
spider.line: Along came a spider. Its web does the sticking.

spoon.name: a spoon
spoon.line: For stirring tea. Or treacle, down the well.

spreadsheet.name: a spreadsheet
spreadsheet.line: Rows and columns. Rungs, if you squint.

square.name: a square
square.line: Four corners, all of them right. How smug.

squiggle.name: a squiggle
squiggle.line: A line that changed its mind. Repeatedly.

squirrel.name: a squirrel
squirrel.line: Busy hiding nuts it will never find again.

stairs.name: stairs
stairs.line: Up and down, like a good argument.

star.name: a star
star.line: Twinkle, twinkle. Up where it belongs.

steak.name: a steak
steak.line: Eat me, medium rare. Up she goes.

stereo.name: a stereo
stereo.line: Music on both sides. Arguments sound better that way.

stethoscope.name: a stethoscope
stethoscope.line: It listens to hearts. The Queen keeps a whole deck.

stitches.name: stitches
stitches.line: They hold things together. A stitch in time, and so on.

stop sign.name: a stop sign
stop sign.line: It says stop. I never take advice from octagons.

stove.name: a stove
stove.line: Pepper in the soup, weight in the iron. The Cook's pride.

strawberry.name: a strawberry
strawberry.line: Eat me, it blushes. A small bite, a small growth.

streetlight.name: a streetlight
streetlight.line: A pole with a halo. Up she shins.

string bean.name: a string bean
string bean.line: Long, thin and good for her. She'll follow suit.

submarine.name: a submarine
submarine.line: Built to sink on purpose. It does it well.

suitcase.name: a suitcase
suitcase.line: Packed for every occasion. Heavy with just-in-case.

sun.name: the sun
sun.line: It rises every morning. Habit, I suppose.

swan.name: a swan
swan.line: All grace above, all paddling below. Off it glides.

sweater.name: a sweater
sweater.line: Knitted by someone's aunt. Light, and slightly itchy.

swing set.name: a swing set
swing set.line: Chains to climb, and a seat for second thoughts.

sword.name: a sword
sword.line: A picture of a sword. Off with nobody's head.

syringe.name: a syringe
syringe.line: A sharp little thing. It stays a drawing, thank you.

table.name: a table
table.line: A little glass table? It stays exactly there.

teapot.name: a teapot
teapot.line: Drink me. There's a Dormouse in it, probably.

teddy-bear.name: a teddy bear
teddy-bear.line: Stuffed with fluff. Soft landings, small bounces.

telephone.name: a telephone
telephone.line: Ring ring. It's for the Hatter. It always is.

television.name: a television
television.line: A window that only looks one way.

tennis racquet.name: a tennis racquet
tennis racquet.line: Strings pulled tight. Things leave faster than they arrive.

tent.name: a tent
tent.line: Canvas and optimism. A breeze could borrow it.

The Eiffel Tower.name: The Eiffel Tower
The Eiffel Tower.line: All rungs and no walls. Paris is that way.

The Great Wall of China.name: The Great Wall of China
The Great Wall of China.line: Solid as a fact, and rather longer.

The Mona Lisa.name: The Mona Lisa
The Mona Lisa.line: She's smiling about something. I know the feeling.

tiger.name: a tiger
tiger.line: Another cousin. Stripes where the grin should be.

toaster.name: a toaster
toaster.line: Pop! Up comes the toast. She may follow.

toe.name: a toe
toe.line: A toe. This little piggy stayed on the board.

toilet.name: a toilet
toilet.line: A throne of sorts. The Queen wouldn't approve.

tooth.name: a tooth
tooth.line: A tooth! Every grin starts somewhere.

toothbrush.name: a toothbrush
toothbrush.line: Essential kit. A grin like mine takes upkeep.

toothpaste.name: toothpaste
toothpaste.line: Minty glue, really. It sticks to everything but teeth.

tornado.name: a tornado
tornado.line: A spin she won't enjoy. Wrong story, anyway.

tractor.name: a tractor
tractor.line: Slow, muddy and heavy. It ploughs on regardless.

traffic light.name: a traffic light
traffic light.line: Red, amber, green. It can't make up its mind either.

train.name: a train
train.line: Heavy, and sticks to its lines. How unimaginative.

tree.name: a tree
tree.line: I'm usually found in one. Do come up.

triangle.name: a triangle
triangle.line: Three corners and a point to make.

trombone.name: a trombone
trombone.line: A trumpet that can't decide how long to be.

truck.name: a truck
truck.line: It will stay where it lands, that one.

trumpet.name: a trumpet
trumpet.line: The Rabbit blows one at trials. Three blasts, then nonsense.

t-shirt.name: a T-shirt
t-shirt.line: Washing-line weight. It flaps when it's pleased.

umbrella.name: an umbrella
umbrella.line: Catch a breeze and up it goes. Nannies swear by it.

underwear.name: underwear
underwear.line: I shan't look. Light as a blush, though.

van.name: a van
van.line: A box on wheels, heavy with parcels.

vase.name: a vase
vase.line: Lovely. Do keep it away from the Duchess's cook.

violin.name: a violin
violin.line: Small, sweet and highly strung. Like the Dormouse.

washing machine.name: a washing machine
washing machine.line: Round and round and going nowhere. Heavy, too.

watermelon.name: a watermelon
watermelon.line: Eat me, it says, in big green letters. Up she goes.

waterslide.name: a water slide
waterslide.line: Down she goes, faster than intended. Wheee, I believe.

whale.name: a whale
whale.line: The heaviest thing I've ever grinned at.

wheel.name: a wheel
wheel.line: Round and ready to roll. It's going places, slowly.

windmill.name: a windmill
windmill.line: It waves at the wind all day. Friendly thing.

wine bottle.name: a wine bottle
wine bottle.line: Drink me. She'll shut up like a telescope.

wine glass.name: a wine glass
wine glass.line: Drink me, daintily. One sip, and down she goes.

wristwatch.name: a wristwatch
wristwatch.line: The Rabbit keeps his in a waistcoat. Same panic, though.

yoga.name: a yoga pose
yoga.line: Bendy as a riddle. It springs back, eventually.

zebra.name: a zebra
zebra.line: A horse that couldn't choose. I respect the indecision.

zigzag.name: a zigzag
zigzag.line: It changes its mind at every corner.
